representation_authority: NONE; this packet defines causal/content topology only and must not imply art direction.
name: Redistributed Finite Bulk Supply
topology_law: A finite bulk shared supply has been persistently redistributed by an earlier human action from one source condition into unequal present destinations. Two distinct people now have materially different access/use relationships to the same finite quantity.
prior_action: A finite bulk quantity was moved/divided from a shared source condition into materially unequal present locations and remains there.
present_relation: Asymmetric availability/allocation of one finite shared quantity; both people have a direct present relation to the redistributed supply.
recoverable_evidence: A visibly depleted source condition together with corresponding present bulk quantities/levels makes the prior shared quantity and redistribution recoverable without numerical labels.
restoration_counterfactual: Returning/reconsolidating the bulk quantity to the shared source would remove the present allocation asymmetry and materially change both people's access/use.

axes.causal carrier locus: finite bulk quantity distributed between source and destinations
axes.current human relation/dependency type: asymmetric access/allocation to one finite shared supply
axes.recoverable evidence type: depleted source plus corresponding unequal bulk quantities/levels

specific_prohibitions: no barrier/gate/path as the main changed condition
